posts.author: edelbrp
posts.content_md:
Reading the billboard hollography thread got me interested in playing with some Lenticular lenses for 3D effects. Specificly I wouldn't mind trying both some printed pieces as well as LCD display (my laptop happens to be exactly 100 DPI).

So, I was thinking about getting both 50 and 100 LPI Lenticulars for my laptop to see what I could do with offset digital photos and Photoshop. Perhaps even make some videos?

Are there any recommendations for vendors or materials?

I found this site informative:

[http://www.mirageworks.net/mw/order.html](http://www.mirageworks.net/mw/order.html)

-Phil

posts.author: edelbrp
posts.content_md:
BTW- A couple sources I've found:

Lenticulars with adhesive (not sure I want to make the modification to my laptop permanent, though ;'):

[http://www.3dphotopro.com/lenses.html](http://www.3dphotopro.com/lenses.html)

Assortment of Lenticulars, but no 50 or 100 lpi:

[http://www.3d-web.com](http://www.3d-web.com)

-Phil

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: Dinesh and Joy make lenticulars and likely can sell you samples of the lenses.

posts.author: edelbrp
posts.content_md:
Well, I ordered the assortment kit from here:

[http://www.3d-web.com/products.php?id=1](http://www.3d-web.com/products.php?id=1)

Too bad I didn't think ahead and order it in time to play with over the extended weekend! Oh well, that's what sick days are for... 

I'm still looking for some 100-lpi material for my laptop's LCD. I see a few places which sell it bulk. I'll bug them for 'samples' next week, I suppose.

Some more good links:

[http://www.stereoscopy.com/faq/lenticular.html](http://www.stereoscopy.com/faq/lenticular.html)

[http://www.rit.edu/~bekpph/Lenticular/553_ref.html](http://www.rit.edu/~bekpph/Lenticular/553_ref.html)

[http://www.artn.nwu.edu/bibliography/00 ... phics.html](http://www.artn.nwu.edu/bibliography/003_006_computers_graphics.html)

Hey Dinesh, I see you are back! I hope you had a good trip. The holograms you shipped me were a great hit during xmas. I had to keep a couple for myself, they were too cool to give away! ;') Have you played with lenticulars on LCD panels?

-Phil

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
Trip was great! Got into a little snafu at the Philly airport due to cancelled flights. It's to be expected, I suppose, over the busiest travelling time of the year. Trivial Security Adjustments required I hand in a gadget to strip the stalks from the leaves of spices - a herb mill. I'm so glad that Our Protectors are so alert. But, all-in-all, it was good.

Glad you likes the holograms.
